rejection.title: Bot validation failed
rejection.rule1: agentrix.json must exist at ZIP root with entrypoint='bot.py' and protocol_version='1.0'.
rejection.rule2: bot.py must have valid Python syntax, load its model in under 10 s and answer every tick in time.
rejection.rule3: The python-stdlib runtime only has the standard library; for numpy, onnxruntime or safetensors declare "runtime": "python-ml-cpu". There is no network.
rejection.downloadReference: Download the Starter Kit to inspect the required structure.

neural.title: Neural network templates
neural.help: Bots that load a model from model/ and run on the python-ml-cpu runtime.
neural.showGuide: How to upload a neural network bot
neural.guideTitle: How to upload a neural network bot

steps.download: Download a template: ONNX uses onnxruntime and NPZ uses numpy. Both are admitted and play as downloaded.
steps.model: Replace the file in model/ with your network (.onnx, .safetensors, .npz or .json) and adapt policy.py to its inputs and outputs.
steps.manifest: Keep "runtime": "python-ml-cpu" in agentrix.json. Open models with relative paths such as model/policy.onnx.
steps.limits: Limits: 50 MB per ZIP, 20 MB per model, 1 core, 1 GB of RAM and 10 s to load the model. Use a single inference thread.
steps.upload: Upload the ZIP: the version stays Validating until the worker tests it, then becomes Admitted or Rejected (with the reason).

neural.runtimeVersions: python-ml-cpu runtime: Python 3.12.14, numpy 2.5.3, onnxruntime 1.30.0 (CPU) and safetensors 0.8.0. No network, no package installs.
